theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+2.27%) and Health Care (+1.45%) led the market today, while Industrials (-1.47%) and Utilities (-1.34%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.38%, defensives +0.49%, and value/cyclicals -0.81% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.21%, Dow -0.12%, Nasdaq -0.09% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.07%. The VIX rose 6.00% to 16.79, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.45% to $4,351.00, crude oil was little changed at $101.89, and bitcoin gained 2.71% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
